newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH OCT BUILDING PERMITS RISE 42 PCT YR/YR - SF.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH OCT BUILDING PERMITS RISE 42 PCT YR/YR - SF.

text.p: The construction volume for which building permits were granted rose 42 percent year-on-year in October to over two million cubic metres, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Friday.
In January-October, the construction volume for which building permits were granted rose 25 percent year-on-year to 27.1 million cubic metres, it said.

Building permits for home construction rose 26 percent year-on-year in January-October to 7.7 milllion cubic metres, and permits for industrial buildings rose 11 percent to 5.3 million cubic metres, it said.
